run_render_pipeline: run the main render pipeline to test Gaussian Splatting models with Lightning and generate output
create_video_from_images: create a video from a folder of PNG images using FFmpeg with configurable framerate and quality
render_original_trajectory: render the original camera trajectory by loading a transforms.json scene and running the test loop
render_novel_view: render a novel view scene by initializing render info and testing the Gaussian Splatting model
generate_rendering_videos: generate MP4 videos from rendered image, depth, normal, and ground truth output folders
